definitions.name: W3A.BRCODE
definitions.body: CHARS 'BC' BIND [ '(' '[' ')' ']' ] [ 1 2 -1 -2 ] RECORD 'BR' BIND BC [ 'CH' BIND BR CH GET ] MAP

definitions.name: W3A.BRSTEP
definitions.body: 'BE' BIND 'BA' BIND BA BE 1 COLLECT CONCAT BA -1 DROP 2 COLLECT 1 0 BA -1 GET 0 BE SUB EQ BE 0 LT AND SELECT GET
definitions.note: FOLD/SCAN step over bracket codes: stack (seed [ 0 ]) pops a matching opener, else pushes the code

definitions.name: W3A.BPSTEP
definitions.body: 'BT' BIND 'BP' BIND BP 0 GET 1 ADD 'BI' BIND BI BI BP 1 GET BT LENGTH 1 EQ SELECT 2 COLLECT
definitions.note: FOLD step over bracket stacks: acc [ position best ] keeps the last position whose stack is just the sentinel

definitions.name: W3A.ARGMAX
definitions.note: numeric Vector -> index of its largest element, first on ties

definitions.name: W3A.LEDGER
definitions.body: ZIP 'LZ' BIND LZ 0 GET LZ 1 GET GROUP 'LG' BIND LG KEYS LG VALUES [ 0 [ ADD ] FOLD ] MAP RECORD
definitions.note: Vector of [ key number ] pairs -> Record key -> sum, keys in first-appearance order

definitions.name: W3A.MODEFIRST
definitions.body: TALLY 'MT' BIND MT KEYS MT VALUES W3A.ARGMAX GET
definitions.note: Vector -> most frequent element, earliest first appearance on ties

definitions.name: W3A.UNWORDS
definitions.body: [ 'UW' BIND ' ' UW 2 COLLECT JOIN ] MAP JOIN TRIM
definitions.note: Vector of space-free Strings -> one String joined by single spaces

definitions.name: W3A.CAP
definitions.body: CHARS 'CC' BIND CC 0 GET UPPER CC 1 DROP JOIN LOWER 2 COLLECT JOIN
definitions.note: non-empty String -> first letter upper case, rest lower case

definitions.name: W3A.RLESTEP
definitions.body: 'RE' BIND 'RA' BIND RA -1 GET 'RL' BIND RA -1 DROP RE RL 1 GET 1 ADD 2 COLLECT 1 COLLECT CONCAT RA RE 1 2 COLLECT 1 COLLECT CONCAT 2 COLLECT 0 1 RL 0 GET RE EQ SELECT GET
definitions.note: FOLD step for run-length encoding: extend the last [ value count ] or append [ value 1 ]

definitions.name: W3A.RLE
definitions.note: Vector -> Vector of [ value count ] per maximal run of equal adjacent values

definitions.name: W3A.UPSTEP
definitions.body: 'UE' BIND 'UA' BIND UA 1 GET 1 ADD 1 UE UA 0 GET GT SELECT 'UR' BIND UE UR UA 2 GET UR MAX 3 COLLECT
definitions.note: FOLD step, acc [ prev run best ], for the longest strictly increasing stretch

definitions.name: W3A.FFSTEP
definitions.body: 'FE' BIND 'FA' BIND FE FA FE NIL? NOT SELECT
definitions.note: SCAN step for forward fill: the element if present, else the accumulator

definitions.name: W3A.PAIRSTEP
definitions.body: 'PE' BIND 'PA' BIND PA 1 GET PE 2 COLLECT
definitions.note: SCAN step leaving [ previous current ] at each position

definitions.name: W3A.QRATIO
definitions.body: 'QP' BIND QP 0 GET 'QA' BIND QP 1 GET 'QB' BIND 1 QB QB NIL? SELECT 1 QA QA NIL? SELECT DIV NIL QA NIL? NOT QB NIL? NOT AND SELECT
definitions.note: [ a b ] -> b / a, or NIL when either is NIL

definitions.name: W3A.MEDIAN
definitions.body: SORT 'MS' BIND MS LENGTH 'MQ' BIND MS MQ 1 SUB 2 DIV FLOOR MQ 2 DIV FLOOR 2 COLLECT GET 0 [ ADD ] FOLD 2 DIV
definitions.note: median of a non-empty numeric Vector
